doc: Audit table of JSON key-paths observed in adapter fixtures and what the corpus projection does with each. Path notation: dotted keys, '[]' marks an array step. Destination categories: 'projected:<column>' = lands in a typed column; 'preserved:<column>' = derived from this path into the column but the raw bytes also survive in entries.raw_json; 'raw_only:<reason>' = only in entries.raw_json (intentional v1 design or accepted gap). Adding a new fixture path that is not in this table fails TestKeyPathCoverage; the fix is to make the deliberate choice and record it here.

paths.message.content[].name: projected:messages.tool_name (tool_use)
paths.message.content[].input.file_path: raw_only:reachable via messages.files_json blob, not a typed column
paths.message.content[].input.pattern: raw_only:reachable via messages.files_json blob, not a typed column
paths.message.content[].id: raw_only:tool_use id, not projected in v1
paths.message.content[].tool_use_id: raw_only:tool_result link, intentional v1: tool_result bodies are not indexed (parser.go:121)
paths.message.content[].content: raw_only:tool_result body, intentional v1: not indexed (parser.go:121)
paths.message.content[].is_error: raw_only:tool_result error flag, intentional v1: not indexed (parser.go:121)
paths.message.usage.cache_creation_input_token: projected:messages.tokens (summed; cache-write split discarded — see cross-agent-data-capture.md)
paths.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens: projected:messages.tokens (summed; cache-read split discarded — see cross-agent-data-capture.md)
paths.firstKeptEntryId: raw_only:Pi compaction node — future column compaction_first_kept_entry_id (cross-agent-data-capture.md priority 3)
paths.tokensBefore: raw_only:Pi compaction node — future column compaction_tokens_before (cross-agent-data-capture.md priority 3)
paths.fromId: raw_only:Pi branch_summary points to alternate-branch start — future column branch_from_entry_id
paths.modelId: raw_only:Pi model_change entry payload — typed column tracked under priority 4 (typed state-transition columns)
paths.provider: raw_only:Pi model_change entry payload — typed column tracked under priority 4
paths.thinkingLevel: raw_only:Pi thinking_level_change entry payload — typed column tracked under priority 4
paths.name: raw_only:Pi session_info entry payload (session rename) — future projection
paths.message.api: raw_only:Pi message envelope (anthropic|openai selector). Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.provider: raw_only:Pi message envelope provider — future messages.provider population (cross-agent-data-capture.md, column exists but unpopulated)
paths.message.model: raw_only:Pi mirrors model at message envelope too. Generic parser already reads message.model into messages.model (parser.go:63); listed here so the corpus walk sees coverage.
paths.message.stopReason: raw_only:Pi assistant stop reason — future projection (analogous to OpenInference llm.finish_reason)
paths.message.responseId: raw_only:Pi provider response id (Anthropic message_id / OpenAI response id) — future projection
paths.message.toolCallId: raw_only:Pi result→call link (their tool_use_id). Parser does not project tool_result linkage in v1 (parser.go:121).
paths.message.truncated: raw_only:Pi truncation marker on truncated outputs — see message.details.truncation.*
paths.message.command: raw_only:Pi BashExecutionMessage command field (separate from generic tool_use). Discovered via pi-mono corpus; Pi-native projection follow-up.
paths.message.output: raw_only:Pi BashExecutionMessage stdout. Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.exitCode: raw_only:Pi BashExecutionMessage exit code. Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.isError: raw_only:Pi error flag at message level. Generic parser only handles content[].is_error (also raw_only).
paths.message.fullOutputPath: raw_only:Pi spillover path when output is truncated to disk — see also message.details.fullOutputPath
paths.message.excludeFromContext: raw_only:Pi custom_message participation bit — column tracked under priority 4 (participates_in_context)
paths.message.timestamp: raw_only:Pi message-envelope timestamp (redundant with entry.timestamp which is already projected)
paths.message.details: raw_only:Pi rich-details object wrapper — see sub-fields
paths.message.details.diff: raw_only:Pi diff text on edit/write entries — future projection
paths.message.details.fullOutputPath: raw_only:Pi spillover path inside details (variant of message.fullOutputPath)
paths.message.content[]: raw_only:empty Pi content array — no leaves; the path is recorded by walker for empty arrays
paths.message.content[].thinking: raw_only:Pi 'thinking' content block body (extended thinking). Parser default-cases this; future projection alongside text.
paths.message.content[].thinkingSignature: raw_only:Anthropic encrypted-thinking signature inside Pi thinking blocks
paths.message.content[].mimeType: raw_only:Pi image content block uses top-level mimeType (not under source.media_type). Parser misses Pi images; Pi-native projection follow-up.
paths.message.content[].data: raw_only:Pi image content block uses top-level data (not under source.data). Parser misses Pi images; Pi-native projection follow-up.
paths.message.content[].partialJson: raw_only:Pi streaming partial-JSON fragment captured mid-stream
paths.message.content[].arguments.command: raw_only:Pi toolCall uses 'arguments' (not 'input'). Parser only handles tool_use blocks (parser.go:108); Pi toolCall blocks fall through. Pi-native projection follow-up — see cross-agent-data-capture.md.
paths.message.content[].arguments.content: raw_only:Pi toolCall arguments — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.context: raw_only:Pi toolCall arguments (Grep context) — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.edits[].newT: raw_only:Pi multi-edit toolCall arguments — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.edits[].oldT: raw_only:Pi multi-edit toolCall arguments — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.limit: raw_only:Pi toolCall arguments (paging) — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.literal: raw_only:Pi toolCall arguments (literal-mode flag) — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.newText: raw_only:Pi single-edit toolCall arguments — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.offset: raw_only:Pi toolCall arguments (paging) — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.oldText: raw_only:Pi single-edit toolCall arguments — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.path: raw_only:Pi toolCall arguments (Pi uses 'path' not 'file_path') — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.pattern: raw_only:Pi toolCall arguments (Grep) — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.content[].arguments.timeout: raw_only:Pi toolCall arguments (Bash timeout) — Pi-native projection follow-up
paths.message.usage.input: raw_only:Pi token usage uses 'input' (not Anthropic-style 'input_tokens'). Parser sums only snake_case keys (parser.go:72); Pi totals stay 0. Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.usage.output: raw_only:Pi token usage uses 'output' (not 'output_tokens'). Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.usage.cacheRead: raw_only:Pi camelCase variant of cache_read_input_tokens. Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.usage.cacheWrite: raw_only:Pi camelCase variant of cache_creation_input_tokens. Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.usage.totalTokens: raw_only:Pi precomputed total — useful, currently unprojected
paths.message.usage.cost.input: raw_only:Pi tracks per-category cost in source. messages.cost column exists but is never populated by any adapter. Discovered via pi-mono corpus.
paths.message.usage.cost.output: raw_only:Pi per-category cost — future messages.cost_output column
paths.message.usage.cost.cacheRead: raw_only:Pi per-category cost — future messages.cost_cache_read column
paths.message.usage.cost.cacheWrite: raw_only:Pi per-category cost — future messages.cost_cache_write column
paths.message.usage.cost.total: raw_only:Pi precomputed total cost — future messages.cost column
